race.comment: TEASE THE BREEZE (12) placed on debut when doing her best work at Moree. Is sure to have come on from that and will appreciate stretching out the added trip and can get off the mark this time.TITAN OF FURY (9) has the deeper race record, and has ratings littered through his form that measure right up for a maiden of this calibre but his long winless record justifiably tempers any winning confidence. CAPTAINTHUNDERBOLT (2) offers upside fresh and if he's come on during the break he holds appeal. SAMOGON (8) didn't make an impression on debut after showing positive signs at the trials, but the winner has come out and won well again since. Nock's booking is also something to note. Sharp improvement won't shock.
